Package dev.px.core

Class Core

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.Core
public final class Core extends Object
The client. One instance, reached through static accessors.

Replaces the old pattern of eighteen public static manager fields assigned in a hand-ordered block whose constraints were documented in comments. Services declare their dependencies and a ServiceContainer orders startup, so adding one cannot silently break an invariant nobody remembers.

Typical bootstrap from a version adapter: 


 Core core = Core.builder("LeapFrog", "2.0")
         .platform(new ForgePlatform())
         .logger(new Log4jLogger(LOGGER))
         .build();

 core.categories().registerAll(Categories.class);
 core.themes().register(Theme.of("Froggy", Color.rgb(0xADF773), Color.rgb(0x80F393)));
 core.modules().registerAll(new KillAura(), new Sprint(), new Fullbright());
 core.commands().registerAll(new ConfigCommand(), new FriendCommand());

 Render.install(new NanoVGRender2D());
 Render.install(new LegacyRender3D());

 core.start();

Registration happens between build() and start(): categories must exist before modules resolve against them, and themes before a saved selection is looked up.
